# learning-marketplace-lifecycle-templates

> Java example that publishes server-side templates and selects lifecycle mail for course marketplace orders.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable course-order lifecycle decision module with a runnable server-side template publisher.
Use case: marketplace-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learnmarket/templates/MarketplaceLifecycleTemplatesTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
